# Express Cuts Unisex Salon

> Express Cuts is a unisex salon in KR Puram, Bengaluru, offering men's haircuts, beard grooming, facials, hair spa and hair colour services.

## Contact
- Website: https://expresscuts.co.in/
- Address: 25/2, Ayyappa Nagar Main Rd, Priyadarshini Layout, Krishnarajapuram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560037
- Location: Ayyappa Nagar, KR Puram, 2 KM from Hoodi Circle
- Phone: +91 89700 00135
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/918970000135
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/vHPC961Ncd1EBFVN6

## Opening hours
- Monday – Friday: 08:00 AM – 10:00 PM
- Saturday – Sunday: 07:00 AM – 10:00 PM
